column3: Saori Route ・ Plan Execution Report
If that's the case, you should tell him that being an otaku is just who you are.
If he has a problem, then he will pull out of the engagement.
Being an otaku is just who I am...?
There's no doubt this is who I am, and there are people who think we "just like anime."
However, I don't know if it'll be that easy...
For both you and your fiance's sake, you have to make sure he knows that you two getting together is a mistake.
For my fiance's sake...
Yes. You think you both can truly be happy if you base your marriage on a lie?
That is... certainly correct.
But, that would mean betraying my parents.
Your parents!? This is your problem, right? Not your parent's problem!
What do you want to do? What are you thinking?
What do '''you''' want to do? Not your parents... Don't just blindly follow what your parents say! Think for yourself!
I am being supported by my parents.
Despite that, to disobey them... I feel that is just being selfish.
...You really care about your parents.
I do. My family is irreplaceable.
But are you really okay like this?
You can't move forward like this.
Won't saying what you really think make things a lot easier for you?
If you don't, you'll never get anywhere.
It is exactly as you say.
However, how should I face them...?
You can figure that out then and there!
If your parents disown you, then you can join my family.
Ky-Kyousuke-shi!?
My father is a bit stubborn but, if I talk to him, I'm sure he'll understand...
Kirino and my mother will gladly take you in!
Supporting you is no problem.
Ah... That's what you meant...
I was certain that you were thinking of marrying me.
Eh?
Ah, nothing!
Even so... do your words have some sort of magic effect attached?
Just your encouragement has made me feel much better.
Saori...
You should smile is what you mean, right?
Huh!?  As expected, that joke isn't used often...
Fufu... You still have a ways to go.
But you do have spirit!
T-Thanks...
But, as you valued my spirit, don't you have to value your own courage?
But, even then... I still cannot make a decision.
What if my parents hate me for betraying their expectations...?
One can get a new hobby, but one cannot get new parents.
When thinking about them hating me, saying, "We don't need a child like you"... I lose my resolve...
So, you'll just go on the rest of your life regretting your actions?
That is...
Say it, Saori. Your fiance isn't here, or your parents...
Ky-Kyousuke-shi...
I-I... really do not want...
t-this marriage...
...I don't understand...
I just don't know what I should be doing...
Calm down, Saori! Nothing good will happen if you panic.
Is this how you really feel...?
I want to be with my friends... forever, if possible...
But, I'm afraid of betraying my parents...
Saori...
Kyousuke-shi...
Well then, how about spiriting me away?
You're trying to run away again?
I totally understand that you're suffering! With friends and family... I can understand not knowing which to put first.
Still, you have to choose. If you don't, you will lose a part of yourself.
Are you okay with that? Are you okay with denying yourself, and letting yourself drift away?
Kyousuke-shi...
I-I... Can I really choose for myself?
Can I become a main character? Could I think, and act for myself?
Of course you can. This isn't about anyone else. This is your story.
...Hm, that is true.
I should have the right to choose for myself...
I am myself... And that is fine, right?
Yeah, you are yourself.
As an otaku, and as a lady, you're extremely weird but, you're also an irreplaceable friend.
...I understand.
I will retrieve the part of me that I have lost.
I will try, through otaku appeal.
Yes, go for it.
I will!
Ah...Kyousuke-shi, can I ask you something?
Huh, what?
If the next plan goes well, can we... together...
Do what together?
Uh, actually never mind.
Huh, what!? Don't leave me hanging!!
Oh... It just might be a bad omen.
You know, you see it frequently in movies.
When people say, "When the battle ends, marry me" before they die in battle.
Ah... That does happen.
That is why I will tell you when I return.
Okay. If that's what you want.
I'm looking forward to it, so go get 'em.
...I will!
S-Spiriting you away? You mean eloping?
No way, I understand your feelings but, I have my own stuff going on...
...So, could you wait a while for the answer?
Hehe!
Hehe?
Hahaha! I was just joking!
You... tricked me?
Please do not become angry with me! It was just some cute playfulness.
I thought you were serious?!
If you seriously thought that, I thought I would do what I can...
Kyousuke-shi... You would go that far for me?
...Sorry. I was stepping all over your feelings.
But, have I ever been sentimental?
...You mean...
I somehow couldn't say, "You were serious?"
Though, because of you, I believe my burden has been lightened.
I do not know what will happen but... With what I can do, I will give my all.
...Yeah. Go for it, Saori.
Uhg, there is nothing to do but go on a journey to find myself...!
No reaction from Kyousuke-shi, huh...?
All the more reason to disappear without a trace...
Wait, wait, wait! If you go that far, won't your parents be sad?
That is that, and this is this.
Don't make it out to be so simple!
If you have the resolve to disappear then use it to strike!
Kyousuke-shi...
Certainly, now that you say it.
Right?
Huh, I feel as though I can do it.
Yeah, that's the spirit!
Go out and find yourself!
All right. If you're saying it like that.
I will bloom for my own sake!
Even if I end up with a horrible fate...
Don't go weak-minded on me now! Set forth with resolution and return!
Yes, sir!!
